units.source_text: 在相约的后天，即十一月二十五日—这是自十八日以来，时隔七天，又能续弈了。

en.t: On the day after the next as arranged, that is, November twenty-fifth, they were able to resume the game after seven days, for the first time since the eighteenth.

units.source_text: 在棋院举行升段赛期间列席观战的小野田六段和岩本六段，头天晚上也抽空赶来了。

en.t: Onoda, sixth dan, and Iwamoto, sixth dan, who had been attending and watching the promotion matches at the Go Institute, had also found time to come the previous evening.
